title: CO excitation and line energy distributions in gas-selected galaxies
question: What are the CO excitation conditions and spectral line energy distributions (SLEDs) in the interstellar medium of high-metallicity damped Ly-alpha (DLA) absorption-selected galaxies at intermediate and high redshifts?

recipe.goal: Automatic source finding in spectral line cubes
recipe.method: Run automated source finding on spectral windows covering the targeted CO lines using the Smooth + Clip Finder
key_parameters: 4 sigma detection threshold; standard configuration of Smooth + Clip Finder

recipe.goal: Extract CO spectra and measure line fluxes, FWHMs, and luminosities
recipe.method: Determine optimal velocity range for integrated flux density maps iteratively, extract spectra from regions defined by the 3 sigma contour in the moment-0 maps, and measure FWHM directly at 50 per cent of peak flux density
key_parameters: 3 sigma contour aperture in integrated flux density images; FWHM at 50 per cent of peak flux density
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM cosmology with H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7

recipe.goal: Compute CO line ratios and construct CO SLEDs
recipe.method: Calculate CO line flux density ratios S_u/S_l and line luminosity ratios r_ul = L'_CO(u-[u-1]) / L'_CO(l-[l-1]) anchored to the lowest available CO transition for each galaxy
assumptions: 5 per cent systematic flux density scale uncertainty interpreted as 2 sigma

recipe.goal: Extract optical photometry and perform broad-band SED fitting and modified black body dust modelling
recipe.method: Extract 1D MUSE spectrum in 1 arcsec aperture for B1228-113 and integrate with SDSS g, r, i filters; fit broad-band optical-to-mm SEDs of B1228-113 and J0918+1636 with MAGPHYS; rescale mm photometry with a modified black body (MBB) curve to derive M_dust and L_850um
key_parameters: 1 arcsec diameter aperture for MUSE extraction; E_{B-V} = 0.0335 Galactic reddening correction
assumptions: MBB parameters: beta = 1.8 +/- 0.2, k_0 = 5.1 cm^2 g^-1 at rest-frame 250 um, T_dust = 35 +/- 5 K

recipe.goal: Derive CO(1-0) luminosities and molecular gas masses from dust and mid-J CO
recipe.method: Compute L'_CO(1-0) and M_mol from rest-frame 850 um luminosity using Scoville et al. (2016) scaling; compute L'_CO(1-0) and M_mol from mid-J CO using r_31 = 0.55 and r_31 = 1; compute M_mol^dust from MBB dust mass and metallicity-dependent gas-to-dust ratio delta_GDR
assumptions: M_HI approx M_mol, so delta_GDR * M_dust approx 2 * M_mol
Fundamental Mass Metallicity relation (Mannucci et al. 2010) rescaled to Pettini & Pagel (2004)
